8.4.1.v: After र् and ष् , the ण् is the substitute of न् , when they occur as component letters in the same word.
8.4.1.e: a नकार occurring immediately after ष् or र्  in the same पद is converted to a णकार.
8.4.1.sa: समानपदे रेफात् षकारात् वा परस्य नकारस्य संहितायाम् णत्वं भवति ।
8.4.1.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.2.v: The substitute ण् takes the place of न् , even when a vowel or य् , व् , ह् or a guttural, or a labial, or the preposition आ , or the augment नुम् intervenes, causing separation.
8.4.2.e: a नकार occurring after ष् or र् in the same पद is converted to a णकार even when it is separated from the ष् or र्  by one or more letters from the अट् प्रत्याहार, कवर्ग, पवर्ग, आङ् , or अनुस्वार.
8.4.2.sa: रेफात् षकारात् परस्य नकारस्य णकारादेशः अट्-वर्णस्य, कवर्गीयवर्णस्य, पवर्गीयवर्णस्य, आङ्-अस्य उपसर्गस्य, अनुस्वारस्य च व्यवधाने अपि भवति ।
8.4.2.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.3.v: So also, न् is replaced by ण् , when the letter occasioning the substitution, occurs in the first member of a compound, and the whole compound is a Name, provided that the first member does not end with the letter ग।
8.4.3.e: For a समस्तपद which is defined as a संज्ञा, The र् and ष् present in the  पूर्वपद causes the णत्वम् of नकार from the उत्तरपद, as long as there is no गकार in between.
8.4.3.sa: समस्तपदस्य पूर्वपदे स्थिताभ्याम् रेफषकाराभ्यामुत्तरपदस्थस्य नकारस्य 'संज्ञायाः विषये' णकारादेशः भवति । परन्तु उभयोः पदयोः मध्ये गकारस्य व्यवधानमस्ति तत्र णत्वं न दृश्यते ।
8.4.3.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.4.v: The न of वन , is changed into ण , when preceded by the words पुरगा , मिश्रका , सिध्रका , शारिका , कोटरा and अग्रे , as first members of the compound, and the whole compound is a name.

8.4.5.v: The न of वन , is replaced by ण , even when the compound is not a Name, when it is preceded by the words प्र , निर् , अन्तर , शर , इक्षु , प्लक्ष , आम्र , कार्ष्य , खदिर and पीयूक्षा।

8.4.6.v: The न of वन , is optionally replaced by ण , when the cause of change occurs in the first member of the compound and which denotes a perennial herb or forest tree.

8.4.7.v: The ण is the substitute of न of अहन् , when it is preceded by a word ending in अ , having in it a letter capable of producing a change.

8.4.8.v: The न of वाहन is changed into ण , when the letter producing the change, occurs in the first member of a compound, denoting the thing carried.

8.4.9.v: The न of पान is changed into ण , when occurs as the second member of a compound, the first member of which contains a letter causing change; and the whole compound denotes a country or people.

8.4.10.v: Optionally when the compound denotes a condition or an instrument, the न् of पान is changed to ण , when it is a second member, the cause of change occurring in the first member in a compound.

8.4.11.v: Optionally ण is substituted for न when it stands at the end of a Nominal-stem (प्रातिपदिक) or is the augment नुम् or is न of a case-affix, (when the cause of change occurs in the first member of the compound).

8.4.12.v: In a compound, the second member of which is a monosyllable, there is ण in the room of न of the second member, provided that the न is at the end of a प्रातिपदिक , or is the augment नुम् , or occurs in a विभक्ति; and when the first member contains a cause of change.
8.4.12.e: For a समस्तपद,  a रेफ or a षकार present in the पूर्वपद  causes the णत्व of the नकार present in the  एकाच् उत्तरपद whenever the नकार is (1) at end of a प्रातिपदिक, or (2) created due to a  नुमागम, or (3) part of a विभक्ति.
8.4.12.sa: पूर्वपदस्थेन णत्वनिमित्तकवर्णेन प्रातिपदिकान्तस्य/नुमागमस्य/विभक्तेः एकाच्-उत्तरपदस्य नकारस्य णत्वं भवति, स च अट्-कु-पु-आङ्-नुम्-एतेषां व्यवधानेऽपि भवति ।
8.4.12.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.13.v: In a compound, the second member of which contains a guttural, there is ण in the room of न , that follows anything which standing in the prior member is qualified to cause the change, provided the न be at the end of a प्रातिपदिक , or be the augment नुम् , or occur in a विभक्ति।
8.4.13.sa: समस्तपदस्य अनेकाच्-उत्तरपदे कवर्गीयवर्णः अस्ति चेत् पूर्वपदस्थेन णत्वनिमित्तकवर्णेन उत्तरपदस्य प्रातिपदिकान्तस्य/नुमागमस्य/विभक्तेः नकारस्य णत्वं भवति, स च अट्-कु-पु-आङ्-नुम्-एतेषां व्यवधानेऽपि भवति ।
8.4.13.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.14.v: Of a root which has ण in its original enunciation, when it comes after a cause of such change standing in an उपसर्ग , even though the word be not a समास , the न is changed to ण।
8.4.14.e: A धातु which has णकार in the औपदेशिक form get णत्वम्   in presence of an उपसर्ग  that has रेफ or षकार.
8.4.14.sa: यस्मिन्  धातौ औपदेशिकावस्थायां णकारः अस्ति, तस्य नकारस्य णत्वनिमित्तकात्  उपसर्गात् परः णकारः भवति ।
8.4.14.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.15.v: The न of हिनु and मीना is changed to ण , when coming after an उपसर्ग containing in it a cause of change.
8.4.15.e: The  नकार associated with the forms of the verbs  हि and  मी is converted to णकार in presence of a रेफयुक्त उपसर्ग.
8.4.15.sa: णत्वनिमित्तकात् उपसर्गात् परस्य हि-धातोः मी-धातोः च नकारस्य णत्वं भवति ।
8.4.15.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.16.v: The न of आनि , the affix of the Imperative, First Person, is changed into ण when it follows a letter competent to cause such a change standing in an उपसर्ग।
8.4.16.e: A रेफ present in an  उपसर्ग causes the णत्व of  नकार of the  'आनि' प्रत्यय of लोट्-लकार.
8.4.16.sa: लोट्-लकारस्य 'आनि' इत्यस्य नकारस्य उपसर्गस्थ-रेफ/षकार-ऋवर्णेन णत्वं भवति ।
8.4.16.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.17.v: The ण is the substitute of न् of the prefix नि , following a cause for such change standing in an उपसर्ग when these words follow - गद 'to speak', नद 'to be happy', पत 'to fall', पद 'to go'; the घु verbs - मा 'to measure', शो 'to destroy', हन् 'to kill', या 'to go', वा 'to blow', द्रा 'to flee', प्शा 'to eat', वप् 'to weave', वह् 'to bear', शम् 'to be tranquil', चि 'to collect', and दिह् 'to anoint'.
8.4.17.e: A णत्वनिमित्तक उपसर्ग causes the  णत्व of the उपसर्ग 'नि' attached to the following verbs -  गद्, नद्, पत्, पद्, मा, सो, हन्, या, वा, द्रा, प्सा, वप्, वह्, शम्, चि, दिह् , and also for घुसंज्ञक verbs.
8.4.17.sa: गद्, नद्, पत्, पद्, मा, सो, हन्, या, वा, द्रा, प्सा, वप्, वह्, शम्, चि, दिह् धातूनां योगे, तथा घुसंज्ञकधातूनां योगे णत्वनिमित्तकात् उपसर्गात् परस्य 'नि' उपसर्गस्य णत्वं भवति
8.4.17.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.18.v: In the remaining verbs, optionally the न of नि is replaced by ण , when it is preceded by an उपसर्ग competent to cause the change; provided that, in the original enunciation, the verb has not an initial क or ख , nor ends with ष।
8.4.18.e: A णत्वनिमित्तक उपसर्ग causes an optional णत्व of the उपसर्ग 'नि' attached to the verbs that are not ककारादि, not खकारादि, not षकारान्त and not mentioned in > [[8.4.16]] sutra.
8.4.18.sa: उपदेश-अवस्थायाम् यः धातुः अककारादिः /अखकारादिः/ अषकारान्तः तथा > [[8.4.16]] इत्यत्र च न निर्दिष्टः अस्ति, तेन सह प्रयुक्तस्य 'नि' उपसर्गस्य णत्वनिमित्तक-उपसर्गस्य उपस्थितौ वैकल्पिकं णत्वं भवति ।
8.4.18.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.19.v: The न of the verb अन् 'to breathe', is changed to ण , when preceded by an उपसर्ग competent to produce the change.
8.4.19.e: The नकार of the verb 'अन् (प्राणने)' becomes णकार when the verb is used along with an उपसर्ग that could cause the णत्व to happen (like प्र or परा).
8.4.19.sa: रेफयुक्तात् उपसर्गात् परस्य 'अन् (प्राणने)' धातोः नकारस्य णकारादेशः भवति ।
8.4.19.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.20.v: The न of the verb अन् 'to breathe', is changed to ण , when preceded by an उपसर्ग competent to produce the change, provided it occurs at the end of a पद।
8.4.20.e: When the verb अन् (प्राणने) is used along with a रेफ/षकारयुक्त उपसर्ग (like प्र or परा), its नकार becomes णकार when it appears at the end of a पद.
8.4.20.sa: रेफयुक्तात् उपसर्गात् परस्य 'अन् (प्राणने)' धातोः पदान्तनकारस्य  णकारादेशः भवति ।
8.4.20.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.21.v: Both the न-s are changed into ण in the reduplicated forms of the verb अन् , when preceded by an उपसर्ग competent to cause the change.
8.4.21.e: When the verb अन् (प्राणने) is used along with a रेफ/षकारयुक्त उपसर्ग (like प्र or परा), and when such a verb undergoes a द्वित्व, then both of the नकारs become णकार.
8.4.21.sa: रेफयुक्तात् उपसर्गात् परस्य 'अन् (प्राणने)' धातोः द्वित्वं कृतमस्ति चेत्  उभयोः नकारयोः णकारादेशः भवति ।
8.4.21.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.22.v: The न , when preceded by अ , in the root हन् , is changed to ण , when the verb is preceded by a preposition competent to cause the change.
8.4.22.e: When the word हन्  comes after an उपसर्ग containing a रेफ, the नकार of हन् is converted to णकार only if that नकार is preceded by an अकार, not otherwise.
8.4.22.sa: रेफयुक्त-उपसर्गात् परस्य हन्-धातोः नकारस्य णत्वं तदैव भवति यदा नकारात् पूर्वमकारः आगच्छति ।
8.4.22.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.23.v: Optionally when व or म follow, the न of हन् is changed to ण , when preceded by an उपसर्ग competent to cause the change.
8.4.23.e: When the word हन्  comes after an उपसर्ग containing a रेफ, and when the नकार of हन् is preceded by a ह्रस्व अकार,  this नकार is optionally converted to णकार in presence of a प्रत्यय that begins with a वकार or a मकार.
8.4.23.sa: रेफयुक्त-उपसर्गात् परस्य हन्-धातोः नकारस्य  वकारादौ मकारादौ प्रत्यये परे  विकल्पेन णत्वं भवति ।
8.4.23.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.24.v: The न preceded by short अ of the root हन् is changed into ण , when the root follows the उपसर्ग - अन्तर and the word does not mean 'a country'.
8.4.24.e: The नकार of हन् is converted to णकार when this word follows the word 'अन्तर्' and when this नकार is preceded by a ह्रस्व अकार. But this णत्व does not happen if the resultant word indicates the name of a place.
8.4.24.sa: 'अन्तर्' इत्यस्मात् उत्तरस्य 'हन्' धातोः नकारस्य तदैव णत्वं भवति यदा नकारात् पूर्वं ह्रस्वः अकारः विद्यते । परन्तु निर्मितेन शब्देन देशस्य निर्देशः कर्तव्यः अस्ति चेत् णत्वं न विधीयते ।
8.4.24.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.25.v: The न of अयन is changed to ण , when preceded by the word अन्तर् and the word does not denote a country.
8.4.25.e: The नकार of अयन is converted to णकार when this word follows the word 'अन्तर्'.  But this णत्व does not happen if the resultant word indicates the name of a place.
8.4.25.sa: 'अन्तर्' शब्दात् परः विद्यमानस्य 'अयन' शब्दस्य नकारस्य णकारादेशः विधीयते । परन्तु निर्मितेन शब्देन देशस्य नाम्नः निर्देशः कर्तव्यः अस्ति चेत् एतादृशम् णत्वं न भवति ।
8.4.25.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.26.v: In the छन्दस् , न of a second term is changed into ण , when prior term ends with a short ऋ even when there is an अवग्रह or hiatus between the two terms.

8.4.27.v: In the छन्दस् , the न of (the Pronoun) नस् is changed into ण , when it comes after a root having a र or ष or after the words उरु and षु (सु)।

8.4.28.v: The न of नस् is changed diversely into ण , when it comes after an उपसर्ग having a cause of change.

8.4.29.v: The न of कृत् affix, preceded by a vowel, is changed into ण , when it follows an उपसर्ग having the cause of change.
8.4.29.sa: रेफयुक्तेन उपसर्गेण सह प्रयुज्यमानात् धातोः  विहितस्य कृत्-प्रत्ययस्य अच्-वर्णात् परस्य नकारस्य णत्वं भवति ।
8.4.29.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.30.v: The न of कृत् affix ordained after a causative verb (णयन्त), is optionally changed into ण , when it comes after an उपसर्ग having a cause of change.
8.4.30.sa: रेफयुक्तेन उपसर्गेण प्रयुज्यमानात् णिजन्तधातोः विहितस्य कृत्-प्रत्ययस्य अच्-वर्णात् परस्य नकारस्य विकल्पेन णत्वं भवति ।
8.4.30.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.31.v: The कृत् affix, coming after a verb, which begins with a consonant and has a penultimate इच् vowel, changes optionally its न् , which is preceded by a vowel, into ण् , when it comes after उपसर्ग having a cause of change.

8.4.32.v: A कृत् affix ordained after a verb beginning with an इच् vowel, having the augment नुम् in it, and ending with a consonant, changes it s न् into ण् , when preceded by an उपसर्ग having in it the cause of change.

8.4.33.v: The न् of निस् , निक्ष and निन्द is changed to a ण optionally, when preceded by an उपसर्ग having in it a cause of change.

8.4.34.v: The न of a कृत् affix is not changed to ण , though preceded by an उपसर्ग having in it a cause of change, when the affix is added to the following verbs - भा 'to shine', भू 'to be', पू 'to purify', कमि 'to be brilliant', गमि 'to go', प्यायि 'to increase', वेप 'to shake'.

8.4.35.v: After a ष् final in a पद , the न् is not changed to ण।

8.4.36.v: ण् is not the substitute of the verb नश 'to destroy', when ending in ष्।

8.4.37.v: Of a न् final in a पद , ण् is not the substitute.
8.4.37.e: A नकार occurring at end of a पद does not get णत्वम् ।
8.4.37.sa: रेफषकारात् परस्य पदान्तनकारस्य णत्वं न भवति ।
8.4.37.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.38.v: The न् is not changed to ण् when a पद intervenes between the cause of the change and the word containing the न्।

8.4.39.v: The ण् is not the substitute of न् in the words क्षुभ्ना etc.

8.4.40.v: The letters स् and the dentals when coming in contact with श् and the palatals, are changed to श् and palatals respectively.
8.4.40.e: In the context of संहिता, A सकार and a तवर्ग letter are converted (respectively) to a  शकार and चवर्ग letter when associated with a शकार or a चवर्ग letter.
8.4.40.sa: सकारतवर्गयोः शकारचवर्गाभ्यां योगे संहितायाम् शकारचवर्गौ स्तः ।
8.4.40.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.41.v: The letters स् and the dentals when coming in contact with ष् and the cerebrals, are changed to ष् and cerebrals respectively.
8.4.41.e: In the context of संहिता, A सकार and a तवर्ग letter are converted (respectively) to a षकार and टवर्ग letter when associated with a षकार or a टवर्ग letter.
8.4.41.sa: सकारतवर्गयोः षकारटवर्गाभ्यां योगे संहितायाम् षकारटवर्गौ स्तः ।
8.4.41.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.42.v: After टु final in a पद , the change of a dental (स्तु) to a cerebral (ष्टु), does not take place, except in the case of the affix नाम्।
8.4.42.e: Except when followed by the प्रत्यय नाम्, a पदान्तटवर्ग letter does not cause the ष्टुत्वम् of  सकार or a तवर्ग letter that follows it.
8.4.42.sa: पदान्तटवर्गात् परस्य सकारतवर्गयोः ष्टुत्वं न भवति ; परन्तु षष्ठीबहुवचनस्य 'नाम्' प्रत्यये परे ष्टुत्वम् अवश्यं भवति ।
8.4.42.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.43.v: In the room of तु there is not a cerebral substitute, when ष् follows.
8.4.43.e: A तवर्ग letter which is followed by a षकार does not undergo  ष्टुत्वम्.
8.4.43.sa: तवर्गस्य षकारे परे ष्टुत्वं न भवति ।
8.4.43.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.44.v: In the room of तु there is not a palatal substitute, when श् precedes.
8.4.44.e: A तवर्गीय letter following a शकार does not undergo श्चुत्वम्.
8.4.44.sa: शकारात् परस्य तवर्गीयवर्णस्य श्चुत्वम् न भवति ।
8.4.44.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.45.v: In the room of a यर् letter (every consonant except ह final) in a पद , when Nasal follows, there is optionally a Nasal substitute.
8.4.45.e: A यर् letter occurring at end of a  पद is optionally converted to an अनुनासिक when it is followed by an अनुनासिक.
8.4.45.sa: पदान्ते विद्यमानस्य यर्-वर्णस्य अनुनासिके परे विकल्पेन अनुनासिकादेशः भवति ।
8.4.45.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.46.v: There is reduplication of यर् , i.e. all the consonants except ह after the letters र् and ह् following a vowel.
8.4.46.e: If र् or ह् is present after अच् letter, then a यर् letter occurring after such a र् or ह् is optionally duplicated.
8.4.46.sa: अचः परस्य यौ रेफहकारौ, ताभ्याम् परस्य यरः द्वे वा स्तः ।
8.4.46.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.47.v: When a vowel does not follow, there is reduplication of यर् (all consonants except ह) after a vowel.
8.4.47.e: The यर् letter that  follows an अच्  letter but is not followed by an अच्  letter is optionally duplicated.
8.4.47.sa: अच्-वर्णात् परः यः यर्-वर्णः, तस्मात् अनन्तरम् अच्-वर्णः नास्ति चेत् तस्य यर्-वर्णस्य विकल्पेन द्वित्वं भवति  ।
8.4.47.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.48.v: There is not reduplication of the letters of पुत्र , when the word आदिनी follows, the sense being that of reviling or cursing.
8.4.48.e: The तकार of the word पुत्रादिनी does not get a द्वित्व when this word is used while shouting / while talking in angry tone.
8.4.48.sa: 'पुत्रादिनी' शब्दस्य तकारस्य आक्रोशे गम्यमाने द्वित्वम् न भवति ।
8.4.48.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.49.v: There are not two in the room of a sibilant (शर्), when a vowel follows.
8.4.49.e: A शर्-letter does not undergo द्वित्वम् when followed by an अच् letter.
8.4.49.sa: शर्-वर्णस्य अच्-वर्णे परे द्वित्वम् न भवति ।
8.4.49.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.50.v: According to the option of शाकटायन , the doubling does not take place when the conjunct consonants are three or more in number.
8.4.50.e: According to शाकटायन, when three or more letters are joined using a संयोग, the द्वित्वम् does not happen.
8.4.50.sa: शाकटायनस्य मतेन त्रयाणाम् उत अधिकानाम् वर्णानाम् संयोगे यर्-वर्णस्य द्वित्वम् न भवति ।
8.4.50.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.51.v: According to the opinion of शाकल्य , there is reduplication no where.
8.4.51.e: According to शाकल्य, a यर् letter is never duplicated.
8.4.51.sa: शाकल्यमुनेः मतेन यरः कुत्रापि द्वित्वम् न भवति ।
8.4.51.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.52.v: According to the opinion of all the Teachers, there is no doubling after a long vowel.
8.4.52.e: According to various experts, a यर्-letter following a दीर्घ letter does not undergo द्वित्वम्.
8.4.52.sa: भिन्नानाम् आचार्याणाम् मतेन दीर्घवर्णात् परस्य यर्-वर्णस्य द्वित्वं न भवति ।
8.4.52.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.53.v: In the room of झल् letters, there is substitution of जश् letters, when झश् letters follow.
8.4.53.e: A झल्-letter is converted to a corresponding जश्-letter when followed by a झश् letter.
8.4.53.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.54.v: The चर् is also substitute of झल् letters occurring in a reduplicate syllable, as well as जश्।
8.4.54.e: A झल् letter present in an  अभ्यास is converted either to a जश् letter or a चर् letter as appropriate.
8.4.54.sa: अभ्यासे विद्यमानस्य झल्-वर्णस्य यथायोग्यम् जश्/चर्-आदेशः भवति ।
8.4.54.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.55.v: In the room of झल् , there is the substitute चर् , when खर् follows.
8.4.55.e: A झल्-letter is converted to a corresponding चर्-letter when followed by a खर्-letter.
8.4.55.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.56.v: The चर् is optionally the substitute of a झल् that occurs in a Pause.
8.4.56.e: A झल्  letter is optionally converted to a corresponding चर् -letter when it is not followed by any other letter.
8.4.56.sa: अवसाने परे झल्-वर्णस्य विकल्पेन चर्-वर्णादेशः भवति ।
8.4.56.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.57.v: The अनुनासिका is optionally the substitute of an अण् vowel which occurs in a Pause, and is not a परिगृह्य।
8.4.57.e: The अण् letter of a non-प्रगृह्य word becomes अनुनासिक optionally when it is followed by an अवसान.
8.4.57.sa: प्रगृह्यसंज्ञकं विहाय अन्यशब्दस्य अण्-वर्णस्य अवसाने परे विकल्पेन अनुनासिकादेशः भवति ।
8.4.57.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.58.v: In the room of अनुस्वारा, when यय् follows, a letter homogenous with the latter is substituted.
8.4.58.e: An अनुस्वार when followed by a यय् वर्ण is converted to the परसवर्ण.
8.4.58.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.59.v: In the room of अनुस्वारा, final in a पद, the substitution of a letter homogenous with the latter is optional.
8.4.59.e: An अनुस्वार occurring at end of a पद when followed by a यय् वर्ण is optionally converted to the परसवर्ण.
8.4.59.sa: पदान्ते विद्यमानस्य अनुस्वारस्य यय्-वर्णे परे विकल्पेन परसवर्णादेशः भवति ।
8.4.59.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.60.v: In the room of तु (a dental) when the letter ल follows, one homogenous with the latter is substituted.
8.4.60.e: A letter of तवर्ग is converted to a परसवर्ण when followed by a लकार.
8.4.60.sa: तवर्गीयवर्णस्य लकारे परे संहितायाम् परसवर्णः भवति ।
8.4.60.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.61.v: After उद्, in the room of the स of स्था or स्तम्भ, the substitute is a letter belonging to the class of the prior (i.e. a dental is substituted for this स).
8.4.61.e: The स्था and स्तम्भ् are converted to पूर्वसवर्ण when they follow the upasarga उत् ।
8.4.61.sa: उद्-उपसर्गात् परस्य स्था-धातोः स्तम्भ-धातोः पूर्वसवर्णादेशः भवति ।
8.4.61.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.62.v: In the room of ह after (a sonant Mute) there is optionally a letter homogenous with the prior.
8.4.62.e: A हकार following a झय् letter is optionally converted to the पूर्वसवर्ण (i.e. वर्गचतुर्थ).
8.4.62.sa: झय्-वर्णात् परस्य हकारस्य विकल्पेन पूर्वसवर्णः (वर्गचतुर्थः) आदेशः भवति ।
8.4.62.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.63.v: in the room of श preceded by a surd Mute, there is optionally the letter छ् when a vowel or य, व or र follows such श।
8.4.63.e: A  शकार sandwiched between a झय् letter on the left and an अट् letter on the right is optionally converted to a छकार.
8.4.63.sa: झय्-वर्णात् परस्य शकारस्य अट्-वर्णे परे विकल्पेन छकारादेशः भवति ।
8.4.63.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.64.v: After a consonant, the following semi-vowel or a nasal is elided optionally, when the same letters follow it
8.4.64.e: A यम्-letter sandwiched between a हल्-letter (on left) and the same  यम्-letter (on right) is optionally removed.
8.4.64.sa: हल्-वर्णात् परस्य यम्-वर्णस्य यम्-वर्णे परे विकल्पेन लोपः भवति ।
8.4.64.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.65.v: The mute of sibilant (झर्) preceded by a consonant and followed by a homogenous mute of sibilant, is optionally elided
8.4.65.e: A झर् letter coming after an हल्  letter is optionally deleted if it is followed by a सवर्ण झर् letter.
8.4.65.sa: हलः परस्य झर्-वर्णस्य सवर्णे झर्-वर्णे परे विकल्पेन लोपः भवति ।
8.4.65.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

8.4.66.v: The स्वरित is the substitute of an अनुदात्त vowel which follows an उदात्त vowel.

8.4.67.v: All prohibit the above substitution of स्वरित, except the आचार्याः - गार्ग्य, काश्यप and गाल्व; when an उदात्त or a स्वरित follows.

8.4.68.v: The अ which was considered to be open (विवृत) in all the preceding operations of the Grammar, is now made contracted (संवृत)
8.4.68.e: The ह्रस्वः अकारः which was being treated as विवृत during the प्रक्रिया now becomes संवृतः for प्रयोग.
8.4.68.sa: प्रक्रियादशायां विवृत: ज्ञापितः ह्रस्वः अकारः इतः परम्  संवृतः ज्ञातव्यः ।
8.4.68.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation
